question: Under what condition is mantra placement to be done on the bathing altar, addressed to the twice-born?
premises: The place is the bathing altar.
Mantra placement may be done there, addressed to twice-born.
inference: If movable, then on the bathing altar mantra placement may be done, O twice-born.
uncertainties: What is movable is not named in these tokens.
plain_english: If movable, on the bathing altar mantra placement may be, O twice-born.
